evidence.text: Domios combines Rust, Tauri v2, React, TypeScript, xterm.js and SQLite.
Agents on the same machine share persistent local memory. Shared memory across different machines is on the roadmap.
The full Domios interface is available in a mobile browser over a private Tailnet.
Domios coordinates Orchestrator, Planner and Worker roles.
Built the flagship iOS app with on-device shelf recognition via OpenCV and designed a reusable internal SDK architecture.
